integrity: The exact projection formula follows from a full analytic proof. Supplementary finite integer/rational checks cover 585 spectral-family examples and 23 binomial identities; finite checks do not certify the infinite parameter family.
scientific_limitations: The metric is the unweighted Hamming cube; projection constants are relative to the concrete Lipschitz/free spaces. The homogeneous Krawtchouk kernels and their known sup-norm asymptotics are cited prior facts. No corresponding weighted-cube theorem, independent scientific validation, or absolute projection-constant formula is asserted.
title: Coordinate-shadow norm formula for Walsh projections on Hamming Lipschitz-free spaces
